make.intro: Your card shows your focus time, and if you like your first name and your streak. Sharing earns nothing; it's just fun.
make.squad_name_off: Your squad name is off on cards. Turn it on in Me; all members have to allow it.
make.duration: Focus time is always on the card.
make.never: Points, rewards and rankings never appear on a card.
make.revoked: The card has been withdrawn. The QR now shows that it is no longer available.
make.under_review: This session is still being reviewed. After that you can make a card of it.
make.no_share: Sharing doesn't work here. Save the card and share it yourself.
